Twenty-nine Arcana are bound. Each entry gives the Arcanum's name and the domains it operates in.

ArcanumDomains
Agares (Gorgon)earth · meditation · understanding
Andras (Damocles)dread · hesitation · punishment
Andrealphus (Sky)fog · rain · storms
Andromalius (Unicorn)divination · lightning · punishment
Balam (Enkidu)earth · sandstorms · strength
Barbatos (Kuzunoha)animals · lightning · sorcery
Bathin (Antikythera)space · time · void
Berith (Tubalcain)fire · heat · metal
Bifronsdeath · isolation · melancholy
Buer (Airmid)exorcism · healing · plants
Crocell (Caladrius)exorcism · healing · sunlight
Dantalion (Justice)counsel · faces · secrets
Decarabia (Huginn & Muninn)knowledge · memory · storms
Fafnir (Hoardflame)fire · protection · wealth
Focalor (Tiamat)chaos · saltwater · serpents
Foras (Oak)earth · plants · poison
Furfur (Banshee)birds · curses · wind
Haures (Vanagandr)death · despair · hunger
Marbasmedicine · poisons · witchcraft
Marchosiasfire · loyalty · vigor
Orobas (Ophaniel)judgment · protection · sacrifice
Ose (Qilin)knowledge · prosperity · temperance
Paimon (Nimue)conquest · heroism · leadership
Phenex (Phoenix)cleansing · fire · rebirth
Sabnock (Baihu)beasts · metal · wind
Seere (Harpy)determination · speed · wind
Shax (Moroz)cold · ice · silence
Vepar (Undine)ice · perception · protection
Zagan (Maneki-Neko)coincidences · prosperity · unforeseen events
